definitions.explanation: Widely known by many people. Can describe people, places, or things.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}な⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{有名|ゆうめい}な⟦{歌手|かしゅ}→歌手：00197_kashu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{有名|ゆうめい}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: This dish is famous, isn't it?

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧{有名|ゆうめい}な⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦ピアニスト→ピアニスト：19413_pianisuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: She is one of the most famous Japanese pianists in the world.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{有名|ゆうめい}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なると→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{大勢|おおぜい}→大勢：02850_oozei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}ます→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: This town is famous for its cherry blossoms. Every spring, many people come to see them.

notes:
{有名|ゆうめい} is a na-adjective meaning famous or well-known.

KANJI MEANING:
{有|ゆう} (have) + {名|めい} (name) = "having a name" (notable)

FORMS:
- {有名|ゆうめい}な + noun: famous (attributive)
- {有名|ゆうめい}だ/です: is famous (predicate)
- {有名|ゆうめい}じゃない: not famous
- {有名|ゆうめい}だった: was famous

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{有名|ゆうめい}: famous for ~
- ⟦{世界的|せかいてき}→世界的：20935_sekaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{有名|ゆうめい}: world-famous
- ⟦{有名人|ゆうめいじん}→有名人：17812_yuumeijin⟧: celebrity, famous person

ANTONYM: ⟦{無名|むめい}→無名：13420_mumei⟧ (unknown, obscure)

〜⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{有名|ゆうめい} VS 〜⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{有名|ゆうめい}:
で names what makes something famous — ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{有名|ゆうめい}です (famous for its cherry blossoms). として names the role or category it is famous in — ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{歌手|かしゅ}→歌手：00197_kashu⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{有名|ゆうめい}です (famous as a singer, though he may do other things too).

{有名|ゆうめい} VS ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧:
{有名|ゆうめい} means many people know of it; ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧ means many people like it. The two come apart: a politician can be {有名|ゆうめい} without being ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧, and a neighborhood restaurant can be ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧ without being {有名|ゆうめい}. ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧ is a noun, so it takes ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ある or 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{人気|にんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ある.

REGISTER:
{有名|ゆうめい} itself is neutral — it can report unwelcome fame as easily as welcome fame, and ⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{有名|ゆうめい} (famous in a bad sense) is a common way to say notorious.
